nodes.title: Expose boolean raw retention and issue policy on fetch
nodes.summary: Add raw: bool = False and on_issue: OnIssue = "warn" to both public fetch(selection, ...) and fetch_by_provider(selection, ...), converting the boundary bool to the existing internal RawMode while retaining ADR-0018's invariant that raw=True returns, in result.raw.entries, the exact Payload.content bytes handed to parse and raw=False returns no receipts. Mirror both controls on fetch_by_provider explicitly: at ref 9725f16, fetch and fetch_by_provider converge on rivretrieve._internal.discovery._fetch_provider_series and return the same four-member ObservationResult, with fetch_by_provider differing only by provider partitioning, so withholding the controls would make receipt retention and strict issue handling depend on selection cardinality. Keep per-series provider-handle calls on on_issue="ignore", merge their issues and raw entries first, then apply the caller's policy once to each completed provider result so the default warns and on_issue="raise" refuses actionable merged issues without duplicating warnings; keep OnIssue and RawMode internal and leave the legacy observations/ProviderHandle plumbing intact for m9. Remove only RawMode from src/rivretrieve/__init__.py and update tests/test_package.py's exact-name assertion and identity/import checks for this milestone's one export removal, explicitly preserving every m9-owned legacy name and adding or removing no other public name because the m5/m9 union is reconciled separately. Acceptance evidence in tests/test_fetch.py pins both function signatures and defaults, proves raw=False yields empty RawPayload entries, raw=True on both singular and multi-provider paths preserves every selected series' exact parse-input bytes and matching provider-scoped origins, and proves warn/raise/ignore behavior over issues merged from multiple selected series; package and legacy-observation/provider-handle tests prove RawMode is absent from rivretrieve but remains usable internally. All five required gates succeed independently: uv run ruff format, uv run ruff check --fix, uv run ty check src, uv run pytest with only the two pre-existing missing-folium skips, and uv build; no version bump or tag is made.
